bull_bear.body: Prudent deployment into high-synergy AI/travel tech targets; No dividend mentioned; Reinvestment in bus growth and hotel product-market fit; Share buyback not discussed.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Regulatory changes in aviation (FDTL norms) causing volatility; Railway booking friction (Aadhaar linking); Hotel segment failure to achieve PMF; Execution risk on inorganic AI acquisitions; Base effect from Mahakumbh in Q4FY25.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident and visionary; Emphasizes 'customer-first' during crises; Aggressive on AI adoption ('software is dying'); Pragmatic on margins (growth over profit in buses/hotels); Transparent on one-offs.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: AI handled 90% of voice calls during peak crisis (150k+ calls), proving deflationary impact on opex; Flight revenue grew 49% vs GTV 22% indicating mix shift to international/higher-take-rate products; Bus safety/roadside assistance programs are cost centers designed for long-term trust/stickiness rather than immediate margin.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Balance sheet is net cash: "Total Cash Balance (Including all Fixed Deposits, Mutual Funds etc., Net of Borrowings)" of INR 1,740.01 Cr as at FY26 versus INR 337.35 Cr as at FY25, against borrowings of INR 24.55 Cr.
- FY26 saw a large capital raise and redeployment - net cash from financing activities of INR 1,286.59 Cr and net cash used in investing activities of INR (1,211.09) Cr, with total assets rising to INR 2,541.31 Cr from INR 905.50 Cr.
- Operating cash generation of INR 195.73 Cr in FY26 versus INR 122.21 Cr in FY25.
- Acquisition-led growth is visible in goodwill rising to INR 444.47 Cr (FY26) from INR 259.58 Cr (FY25); the AI strategy explicitly includes "Inorganic investments in disruptive teams & startups".
- Employee stock option scheme charge of INR 48.14 Cr in FY26 versus INR 13.91 Cr in FY25, including a stated one-off ESOP expense of INR 26.93 crores in FY26.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

bull_bear.body:
- scale: market leadership in online train ticketing — evidence: average OTA market share in Trains of 62% during FY26; described as the #1 Train OTA with 104.12 Mn train passenger segments — against it: Indian Railways lengthened the restricted Tatkal window for OTAs, reduced the waitlist pool and made Aadhaar verification mandatory, which moderated industry growth
- customer lock-in: cross-category repeat usage on one multi-brand platform — evidence: 85.55% repeat transaction rate and 56.38 Mn lifetime transacted users; customers acquired in one category transact across trains, flights, buses, hotels and value-added services
- distribution: third-party distribution beyond owned channels — evidence: powers train bookings inside the Rapido app, intercity bus bookings inside the Uber app (6 lakh+ routes across 6,200+ operators), and launched native ixigo Flights & Hotels, AbhiBus and Confirmtkt apps within ChatGPT
- distribution: government bus supply access — evidence: AbhiBus expanded its SRTC network to 22 state-run bus operators, adding eight partnerships during the year
- technology: AI-run customer service at scale — evidence: AI handled nearly 90% of all voice calls in December, managing more than 150,000 calls end-to-end; 81.52% of voice queries and 91.15% of chat queries resolved by AI in the quarter ended March 31, 2026
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Intense competition — The Company says it operates in a dynamic and highly competitive environment, which bears on pricing and market position across its segments.
- Airline operational disruptions — Widespread flight disruptions by a leading airline in India in the latter part of the year doubled customer support reach-outs and forced large-scale refunds and rebooking, including full refunds of convenience and ixigo Assured fees borne by the Company.
- Refund cost borne on value-added services — Customer refund/cancellation costs rose mainly on higher volumes of value-added services where the cost of refund or modification is borne by the Company, so disruption-heavy periods raise its own costs.
- Losses at associates — The share of losses from associates Freshbus and Squad As A Service, S.L. rose and is flagged by management as impacting overall profitability.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Flights: GTV INR 2,055cr (+22%), Rev INR 102.4cr (+49%), CM 39%. Trains: GTV INR 2,095.5cr (+15%), Rev INR 134.1cr (+12%), CM 30%. Buses: GTV INR 671cr (+36%), Rev INR 75.6cr (+47%), CM 45%. Hotels: Pre-PMF, focusing on direct supply via channel managers.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Airline operational disruptions and cancellation backlogs | InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo) | beneficiary | Low | While ixigo gained share, the overall sector stress affects all carriers; ixigo's resilience is specific to its aggregator model. |

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Claims "Established Market Leadership in Online Travel" and "India's Largest Travel Platform", both footnoted as being on the basis of MAU and app downloads, and "Fastest Growing" on the basis of Revenue from Operations CAGR from FY21 to FY26.
- Frames itself as a "'One-stop' Multi-Brand Travel Ecosystem" spanning Flights, Hotels, Trains and Buses, with the stated vision of becoming "the most customer-centric travel company".
- Positions the moat as the "Peace of Mind" business - dynamic AI-based pricing for value-added services such as no-questions-asked full refunds, fully flexible and freely reschedulable tickets, upto 150% assured refund with roadside assistance, lock fare now / pay later, and upto 3X refund on unconfirmed waitlisted train tickets.
- Cites "India's Highest Rated Travel Apps" with 62.32 Lakh+ ratings across apps as of 30th June 2026, feeding a described flywheel where free travel-utility products (PNR status, train running, bus schedules, flight tracking) build trust and convert into transacting users.
- The stated market context is an Indian OTA market growing at an 18% CAGR (FY23-28) versus 13% for the online travel market and 9% for the total market (Source: F&S Report).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisition] 54.66% majority stake acquired in Brevistay, India's largest flexible-stay hotel network, described as the inflection point for the hotels vertical.
- [Macro risk] Co-CEO commentary: "Until the Iran conflict is not fully resolved, we expect some volatility", with the quarter framed as "challenging macro environment" and "much progress and some challenges".
- [Reporting change] Effective 1st April 2026 the presentation currency denomination changed from INR Millions to INR Crores, with comparatives restated.
- [Associate drag] A recurring "Share of loss of an associate, net of tax" of INR (11.22) Cr in FY26, INR (9.10) Cr in FY25 and INR (5.91) Cr in FY24 sits below the operating result.
- [Demand trends] Company data cites short-haul international surges (Vietnam +130%, Sri Lanka +68%, Singapore +32%, Thailand +22% YoY), higher airfares (+38% YoY international, +22% YoY domestic) boosting long-distance bus travel, and Goa flights +15% YoY with hotels +40% vs summer.
business.title: Notable from the deck

business.body: Le Travenues Technology (ixigo), founded in 2007, has evolved from a travel utility platform into an online travel agency operating a one-stop, multi-brand ecosystem (ixigo Trains, ixigo Flights, Confirmtkt and AbhiBus) through which Indian travellers plan, book and manage journeys across trains, flights, buses and hotels. Alongside booking it offers travel utilities (PNR status, live train running status, confirmation prediction, bus schedules, flight tracking) and a 'Peace of Mind' portfolio of value-added services, and serves travel agents and tour operators through its B2B brand Travel Super Mall. Revenue is predominantly ticketing, with advertising and other operating revenue making up the rest.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Trains:** ixigo Trains, Confirmtkt, Ticket booking, PNR status, real-time train tracking, seat availability alerts and confirmation probability prediction, AI Seat Finder (powered by TARA), Train Alternates, Alternate Travel Plan (up to 3X refund on unconfirmed waitlisted tickets), Food on Train (Swiggy partnership), QR-based metro ticketing (Delhi Metro, Mumbai Metro)
- **Flights:** ixigo Flights, Price Lock (lock airfares for up to 14 days), ixigo Assured & Assured Flex, Armed Forces fares, Flight tracking, AI Smart Filters, ixigo Airport Cabs
- **Buses:** AbhiBus, Abhi Assured, Travel Guarantee, Roadside Assistance, Pink Seat, Bus Insights, 360-degree Walk-through, Ready Go platform for bus operators
- **Hotels & others:** ixigo Hotels, HELLO (AI-powered hotel extranet), Brevistay (majority stake, short-stay accommodation), Travel insurance, visa processing, visa rejection protection, seat & in-flight meals
- **AI platform:** ixigo NEXT, TARA (voice and chat assistant), Agentic travel flows, Native apps within ChatGPT for ixigo Flights & Hotels, AbhiBus and Confirmtkt
- **B2B:** Travel Super Mall (distribution platform for travel agents and tour operators)
- **International:** Trenes.com (Spain's second-largest train OTA, 60% stake)

outlook.body: No explicit numerical guidance provided. Management expects train capacity expansion to improve long-term; bus margins to sustain in ~40% range (willing to dip 1-2% for growth); hotel scaling contingent on achieving product-market fit; capex focused on AI and inorganic deals.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: N/A (Transaction-based business model). Key metric: GTV INR 4,902.9cr (+21% YoY).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Inorganic growth via Singapore subsidiary for AI/Travel tech acquisitions; International flights (>50% growth, now 20% of flight GTV); Bus penetration (digital booking <25%); Hotels direct supply integration.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

outlook.body:
- Build a multimodal, one-stop platform across trains, flights, buses, hotels and value-added services, with customers acquired in one category cross-sold into others
- Deepen the 'Peace of Mind' ancillary portfolio (Assured, Assured Flex, Price Lock, Abhi Assured, Alternate Travel Plan, Travel Guarantee, Roadside Assistance) with dynamic AI-based pricing for value-added services
- Embed AI across voice, chat and post-booking support to automate routine interactions and absorb disruption-driven volume spikes
- Expand international flight supply through GDS partnerships with Amadeus and Travelport (Galileo) and 26 airline integrations over NDC channels
- Invest in hotels as a strategic priority: majority stake in Brevistay for short-stay accommodation and the HELLO AI extranet to grow directly contracted supply
- Broaden bus supply and distribution: SRTC network expanded to 22 state-run operators, intercity bus bookings powered on Uber, AbhiBus native app on ChatGPT, and the ReadyGo platform for operators
- Extend the flight journey into first- and last-mile mobility through Airport Cabs, and add payment options (No-Cost EMI, Book Now Pay Later) through bank/NBFC partnerships
- Brand strategy combining product- and data-led storytelling (e.g. The Great Indian Travel Index) with creator, entertainment and sports-led campaigns
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: ixigo is asset-light and expands through platform build-out, supply integrations and acquisitions rather than physical capacity. In FY26 it made its first major international acquisition, a 60% stake in Trenes.com (Spain's second-largest train OTA), marking its entry into Europe, and alongside it took a 45.02% stake in Squad As A Service, S.L. (Sqaas), a Spain-based AI technology company that became an associate. It took a 10.34% stake in Ofintelligence Technologies (ProactAI), a computer-vision company, and subscribed to fully convertible debentures of Forgeurai Systems (Vestra.AI), an AI-native workspace developer. Hotel supply crossed 70,000 properties across India and 1 million worldwide, supported by the AI-first extranet HELLO. Prosus (MIH Investments One B.V.) acquired a 10.1% fully diluted stake through a preferential issue, with funds allocated to AI and technology investments, expanding the hotels business, selective inorganic opportunities and working capital. Distribution and supply partnerships added during the year include OpenAI (Enterprise API and coding models), CRED (exclusive flight bookings for the CRED IndusInd Bank RuPay card), Swiggy (Food on Train), native apps within ChatGPT, Rapido (train bookings), Uber (intercity bus bookings), Fleetx and CheckMyBus, an SRTC network expanded to 22 state-run bus operators, and ixigo Airport Cabs across 100+ cities. Management says it will reinvest part of the operating leverage from trains, flights and buses into AI and Hotels, expects very early results from these investments by the end of FY27, and is developing agents inside ixigo NEXT and training its own small language models.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Flights outperformed a muted market: in Q4 FY26 the domestic flights market grew only 1.3% YoY while ixigo's flight passenger segments grew nearly 14%, reflecting market share gains; flights became the largest business by GTV in Q4 FY26
- Train industry growth was moderated by regulatory changes (extended Tatkal restriction window for OTAs, a lower waitlist ticket pool, mandatory Aadhaar verification) against a high Maha Kumbh base in FY25
- Bus demand was supported by intercity routes, with pilgrimage travel (Tirupati, Nashik, Ujjain, Varanasi, Haridwar) a notable driver; bus was the fastest-growing business and the largest contributor to contribution margin in Q4 FY26
- India's online travel market is projected to grow from USD 23.34 billion in 2025 to USD 38.58 billion by 2031 (8.74% CAGR 2026-2031), supported by air, hotel and bus bookings and demand for curated travel experiences
- The market is expected to remain highly competitive, led by integrated OTAs and supplier-direct platforms, with AI-driven solutions and app enhancements used to lower servicing costs per transaction
- Digital payments, internet and mobile penetration and UDAN regional air connectivity are extending online travel use beyond metropolitan cities
- Macro: GDP projected to grow 6.6%, with private consumption in FY2026-27 expected to be supported by discretionary spending, resilient rural demand and GST rationalisation
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

deepdive.thesis: ixigo delivered record revenue (+31% YoY) and PAT (+54% YoY) in Q3FY26, demonstrating exceptional resilience by gaining flight market share during a major airline crisis through AI-led customer support, while the bus segment continues to compound at 40-50% YoY. The strategic pivot towards inorganic AI investments via a Singapore subsidiary signals a transition from pure organic growth to becoming a consolidated travel-tech platform.

open.item: Reinvest part of the operating leverage from the scaled trains, flights and bus businesses into AI and Hotels, with very early results expected by the end of FY27.
The bus segment strategy continues to prioritise growth over margins in the short to medium term, with sustained investment in penetration, brand recall and product innovation.
Hotels remain a strategic investment priority, built out through the Brevistay majority stake and the HELLO AI extranet for directly contracted supply.
Separate financial disclosure for the Hotels business will begin once it reaches the scale and operating maturity appropriate for standalone reporting (no date given).
Customer grievances are targeted for acknowledgement within 24 hours and resolution within 15 working days.
Hotels remain a strategic investment priority; separate financial disclosure for Hotels will begin once the business reaches appropriate scale and operating maturity.
Proceeds of the Prosus preferential issue are allocated to AI and technology investments, expanding the hotels business, selective inorganic opportunities and working capital.
Develop agents inside ixigo NEXT for automated web check-ins, boarding-pass retrieval, fare monitoring, hotel reconfirmations, refund management, booking reconfirmation and proactive trip monitoring.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Multi-brand online travel agency (ixigo, Confirmtkt, AbhiBus) built for India's Next Billion Users across trains, flights, buses and hotels, with nearly 94% of transactions originating from or destined for Tier II and Tier III cities.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Le Travenues Technology (ixigo), founded in 2007, has evolved from a travel utility platform into an online travel agency operating a one-stop, multi-brand ecosystem (ixigo Trains, ixigo Flights, Confirmtkt and AbhiBus) through which Indian travellers plan, book and manage journeys across trains, flights, buses and hotels. Alongside booking it offers travel utilities (PNR status, live train running status, confirmation prediction, bus schedules, flight tracking) and a 'Peace of Mind' portfolio of value-added services, and serves travel agents and tour operators through its B2B brand Travel Super Mall. Revenue is predominantly ticketing, with advertising and other operating revenue making up the rest.

group_structure.title: Group structure (profile)
group_structure.body:
- Ixigo Europe, S.L. — subsidiary: Wholly owned subsidiary (100%); renders consultancy services to the Company
- IXIGO PTE. LTD. — subsidiary: Wholly owned subsidiary (100%) since December 18, 2025; holding entity for Online Travel Solutions, S.L. (Trenes) and Squad As A Service, S.L.
- Zoop Web Services Private Limited — subsidiary: Subsidiary (62%) since December 2024
- Online Travel Solutions, S.L. (Trenes) — subsidiary: Step-down subsidiary (60%) through IXIGO PTE. LTD., since March 1, 2026
- Squad As A Service, S.L. (Sqaas) — associate: Associate (45.02%) of IXIGO PTE. LTD., since March 25, 2026
- Freshbus Private Limited — associate: Associate (25.66%); the Company earns ticketing and advertisement revenue from it
- SAIF Partners India IV Limited — related party: Listed among other parties with whom transactions (reimbursement of expenses) were undertaken in the previous year
- Peak XV Partners Investments V (formerly SCI Investments V) — related party: Listed among other parties with whom transactions (reimbursement of expenses) were undertaken in the previous year

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: Flights: GTV INR 2,055cr (+22%), Rev INR 102.4cr (+49%), CM 39%. Trains: GTV INR 2,095.5cr (+15%), Rev INR 134.1cr (+12%), CM 30%. Buses: GTV INR 671cr (+36%), Rev INR 75.6cr (+47%), CM 45%. Hotels: Pre-PMF, focusing on direct supply via channel managers.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Trains:** ixigo Trains, Confirmtkt, Ticket booking, PNR status, real-time train tracking, seat availability alerts and confirmation probability prediction, AI Seat Finder (powered by TARA), Train Alternates, Alternate Travel Plan (up to 3X refund on unconfirmed waitlisted tickets), Food on Train (Swiggy partnership), QR-based metro ticketing (Delhi Metro, Mumbai Metro)
- **Flights:** ixigo Flights, Price Lock (lock airfares for up to 14 days), ixigo Assured & Assured Flex, Armed Forces fares, Flight tracking, AI Smart Filters, ixigo Airport Cabs
- **Buses:** AbhiBus, Abhi Assured, Travel Guarantee, Roadside Assistance, Pink Seat, Bus Insights, 360-degree Walk-through, Ready Go platform for bus operators
- **Hotels & others:** ixigo Hotels, HELLO (AI-powered hotel extranet), Brevistay (majority stake, short-stay accommodation), Travel insurance, visa processing, visa rejection protection, seat & in-flight meals
- **AI platform:** ixigo NEXT, TARA (voice and chat assistant), Agentic travel flows, Native apps within ChatGPT for ixigo Flights & Hotels, AbhiBus and Confirmtkt
- **B2B:** Travel Super Mall (distribution platform for travel agents and tour operators)
- **International:** Trenes.com (Spain's second-largest train OTA, 60% stake)

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Indian retail (B2C) travellers across urban, semi-urban and rural geographies, concentrated in Tier II and Tier III cities
- B2B travel agents and tour operators in metropolitan hubs such as New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata
- Europe (Spain) rail travel through the Trenes.com acquisition
- International travellers searching India bus routes via the CheckMyBus partnership; exports are a small share of turnover (0.83%)

order_book.body: N/A (Transaction-based business model). Key metric: GTV INR 4,902.9cr (+21% YoY).

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: No explicit numerical guidance provided. Management expects train capacity expansion to improve long-term; bus margins to sustain in ~40% range (willing to dip 1-2% for growth); hotel scaling contingent on achieving product-market fit; capex focused on AI and inorganic deals.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Inorganic growth via Singapore subsidiary for AI/Travel tech acquisitions; International flights (>50% growth, now 20% of flight GTV); Bus penetration (digital booking <25%); Hotels direct supply integration.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Flights outperformed a muted market: in Q4 FY26 the domestic flights market grew only 1.3% YoY while ixigo's flight passenger segments grew nearly 14%, reflecting market share gains; flights became the largest business by GTV in Q4 FY26
- Train industry growth was moderated by regulatory changes (extended Tatkal restriction window for OTAs, a lower waitlist ticket pool, mandatory Aadhaar verification) against a high Maha Kumbh base in FY25
- Bus demand was supported by intercity routes, with pilgrimage travel (Tirupati, Nashik, Ujjain, Varanasi, Haridwar) a notable driver; bus was the fastest-growing business and the largest contributor to contribution margin in Q4 FY26
- India's online travel market is projected to grow from USD 23.34 billion in 2025 to USD 38.58 billion by 2031 (8.74% CAGR 2026-2031), supported by air, hotel and bus bookings and demand for curated travel experiences
- The market is expected to remain highly competitive, led by integrated OTAs and supplier-direct platforms, with AI-driven solutions and app enhancements used to lower servicing costs per transaction
- Digital payments, internet and mobile penetration and UDAN regional air connectivity are extending online travel use beyond metropolitan cities
- Macro: GDP projected to grow 6.6%, with private consumption in FY2026-27 expected to be supported by discretionary spending, resilient rural demand and GST rationalisation

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: Bus CM compressed 20pp YoY due to aggressive growth strategy (marketing/promotions) and safety initiatives; Management comfortable sustaining ~40% CM, willing to trade 1-2% for scale. Employee costs declined QoQ (INR 46cr to 41cr) due to AI efficiency (TARA handling 90% of crisis calls).

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Prudent deployment into high-synergy AI/travel tech targets; No dividend mentioned; Reinvestment in bus growth and hotel product-market fit; Share buyback not discussed.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: ixigo is asset-light and expands through platform build-out, supply integrations and acquisitions rather than physical capacity. In FY26 it made its first major international acquisition, a 60% stake in Trenes.com (Spain's second-largest train OTA), marking its entry into Europe, and alongside it took a 45.02% stake in Squad As A Service, S.L. (Sqaas), a Spain-based AI technology company that became an associate. It took a 10.34% stake in Ofintelligence Technologies (ProactAI), a computer-vision company, and subscribed to fully convertible debentures of Forgeurai Systems (Vestra.AI), an AI-native workspace developer. Hotel supply crossed 70,000 properties across India and 1 million worldwide, supported by the AI-first extranet HELLO. Prosus (MIH Investments One B.V.) acquired a 10.1% fully diluted stake through a preferential issue, with funds allocated to AI and technology investments, expanding the hotels business, selective inorganic opportunities and working capital. Distribution and supply partnerships added during the year include OpenAI (Enterprise API and coding models), CRED (exclusive flight bookings for the CRED IndusInd Bank RuPay card), Swiggy (Food on Train), native apps within ChatGPT, Rapido (train bookings), Uber (intercity bus bookings), Fleetx and CheckMyBus, an SRTC network expanded to 22 state-run bus operators, and ixigo Airport Cabs across 100+ cities. Management says it will reinvest part of the operating leverage from trains, flights and buses into AI and Hotels, expects very early results from these investments by the end of FY27, and is developing agents inside ixigo NEXT and training its own small language models.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident and visionary; Emphasizes 'customer-first' during crises; Aggressive on AI adoption ('software is dying'); Pragmatic on margins (growth over profit in buses/hotels); Transparent on one-offs.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- scale: market leadership in online train ticketing — evidence: average OTA market share in Trains of 62% during FY26; described as the #1 Train OTA with 104.12 Mn train passenger segments — against it: Indian Railways lengthened the restricted Tatkal window for OTAs, reduced the waitlist pool and made Aadhaar verification mandatory, which moderated industry growth
- customer lock-in: cross-category repeat usage on one multi-brand platform — evidence: 85.55% repeat transaction rate and 56.38 Mn lifetime transacted users; customers acquired in one category transact across trains, flights, buses, hotels and value-added services
- distribution: third-party distribution beyond owned channels — evidence: powers train bookings inside the Rapido app, intercity bus bookings inside the Uber app (6 lakh+ routes across 6,200+ operators), and launched native ixigo Flights & Hotels, AbhiBus and Confirmtkt apps within ChatGPT
- distribution: government bus supply access — evidence: AbhiBus expanded its SRTC network to 22 state-run bus operators, adding eight partnerships during the year
- technology: AI-run customer service at scale — evidence: AI handled nearly 90% of all voice calls in December, managing more than 150,000 calls end-to-end; 81.52% of voice queries and 91.15% of chat queries resolved by AI in the quarter ended March 31, 2026

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Regulatory changes in aviation (FDTL norms) causing volatility; Railway booking friction (Aadhaar linking); Hotel segment failure to achieve PMF; Execution risk on inorganic AI acquisitions; Base effect from Mahakumbh in Q4FY25.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: AI handled 90% of voice calls during peak crisis (150k+ calls), proving deflationary impact on opex; Flight revenue grew 49% vs GTV 22% indicating mix shift to international/higher-take-rate products; Bus safety/roadside assistance programs are cost centers designed for long-term trust/stickiness rather than immediate margin.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Build a multimodal, one-stop platform across trains, flights, buses, hotels and value-added services, with customers acquired in one category cross-sold into others
- Deepen the 'Peace of Mind' ancillary portfolio (Assured, Assured Flex, Price Lock, Abhi Assured, Alternate Travel Plan, Travel Guarantee, Roadside Assistance) with dynamic AI-based pricing for value-added services
- Embed AI across voice, chat and post-booking support to automate routine interactions and absorb disruption-driven volume spikes
- Expand international flight supply through GDS partnerships with Amadeus and Travelport …

other.body:
- [Acquisition] 54.66% majority stake acquired in Brevistay, India's largest flexible-stay hotel network, described as the inflection point for the hotels vertical.
- [Macro risk] Co-CEO commentary: "Until the Iran conflict is not fully resolved, we expect some volatility", with the quarter framed as "challenging macro environment" and "much progress and some challenges".

themes.title: Hospitality & travel up-cycle
themes.need: Q1FY27 split hotels from airlines. INDHOTEL delivered a 17th consecutive record quarter - consolidated revenue INR 2,419cr (+15%), EBITDA INR 753cr at 31.1%, standalone occupancy jumping to 82% from 76% on a 41.8% standalone EBITDA margin, and asset-light management-fee income INR 168cr (+26%) - with management now framing the West-Asia war as a NET tailwind because outbound travel stays home; leisure RevPAR (Rajasthan/Goa) ran up high-20s. Airlines got the mirror image: INDIGO's EBITDAR margin collapsed from 28.0% to 15.6% on blended ATF of ~INR 140-150/litre versus INR 85-90 pre-war (fuel CASK +~80% YoY), leaving yield as the only defence. MHRIL shows domestic leisure premiumisation is real - Keystone average unit realisation +73% to INR 14.4 lakh on stable gross sales. LEMONTREE/CHALET/SAMHI/THELEELA ride the same occupancy-led room cycle; TRAVELFOOD/TBOTEK/DREAMFOLKS remain levered to airport PAX and B2B travel.
themes.driver: Occupancy-led (not rate-led) RevPAR compounding plus INDHOTEL's Ginger conversion cadence stepping 15->20->25->40 per quarter through FY27; for airlines the swing is INDIGO's guided Q2 PRASK growth of 'more than 25%' on flattish capacity against ATF cracks.

themes.title: Digital platforms, SaaS, payments & cybersecurity
themes.need: Digital-public-infrastructure scale, enterprise SaaS and a compliance/security upcycle drive a distinct platform cohort. PINELABS/NPST/CMSINFO on payments; AURIONPRO/NEWGEN/NUCLEUS/ROUTE/TANLA on banking/CPaaS software; EMUDHRA/META(544441)/AURIONPRO on digital-identity & cybersecurity; CAPILLARY/MAPMYINDIA/NAZARA on SaaS/geospatial/gaming. Q1FY27 anchored the payments leg: PAYTM's GMV grew 31% YoY (accelerating 23% -> 27% -> 31%) with merchant payments about 80% of the financial-services mix and 25-30 lakh device additions a year on a distribution-only lending model (no book, no FLDG); MOBIKWIK posted payments GMV of INR 52,400cr (+58% YoY), a 13th consecutive record quarter and India's largest wallet by GTV at ~20% share, against only ~INR 3,200cr of digital-credit GMV. OFSS adds the banking-software annuity, with RPO +17% YoY versus revenue +7% and licence-and-cloud revenue +13% at a 44% operating margin.
themes.driver: Deal/ARR additions; festive digital-payments TPV; merchant-device additions; RBI/regulatory compliance-driven security spend.
